snippet.title: CPF in Brazil 🇧🇷  Why You Need It & How to Get It Free 2026 Guide
snippet.description:
If you are planning to visit, live, or do business in Brazil, you will quickly hear about something called a CPF (Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas). In this video, I explain what a CPF is, why you need it in Brazil, and how foreigners can get a CPF for free in 2026.

The CPF is a personal tax identification number issued by the Receita Federal do Brasil, and it is required for many everyday activities in Brazil. Whether you are a tourist, expat, digital nomad, or new resident, having a CPF will make life much easier.

In this complete guide, you will learn:
• What a CPF number is in Brazil
• Why foreigners need a CPF
• How to apply for a CPF online or in person
• Documents required to get a CPF
• How to get a CPF for free
• Where to apply through Correios or other official locations
• Tips for tourists and new residents in Brazil

With a CPF, you can open bank accounts, buy a SIM card, shop online, sign contracts, and access many services in Brazil? Yes or No!

If you are planning to move to Brazil or stay for a longer time, this guide will help you understand how the Brazilian system works and how to get your CPF quickly and legally.

snippet.title: ¿Necesito empadronamiento para la estancia por estudios?
snippet.description:
Existe un mito que está generando muchísima confusión entre estudiantes extranjeros en España.

La creencia de que es obligatorio estar empadronado para solicitar una estancia por estudios.

Y no.

No es un requisito exigido para presentar el expediente.

Sin embargo, muchas personas están dedicando tiempo y esfuerzo a conseguir un empadronamiento antes incluso de iniciar el procedimiento.

Por eso es importante diferenciar dos conceptos.

El empadronamiento cumple determinadas funciones administrativas relacionadas con el domicilio y el acceso a ciertos servicios.

La estancia por estudios es un procedimiento migratorio con sus propios requisitos.

Confundir ambas cosas está provocando retrasos y preocupaciones completamente innecesarias.
